statement.p: Let t_j denote the time it took Tejay van Garderen to ride the j-th stage of the Tour de France in 2013. If there was a total of 21 stages, interpret \displaystyle{ \sum_{j=1}^{12}t_j }.

\displaystyle{ \sum_{j=1}^{12}t_j} represents
?
the average time it took 12 cyclists to ride each stage.
the time to ride the first 12 stages.
the average distance rode afters 12 stages.

p.m: \text{the time to ride the first 12 stages.}
